findings: Plaintext credential in committed doc — LOGIN_DASHBOARD_FIX_REPORT.md records srujan11 / TestPass123 verbatim and is now in git history. Change the password immediately and remove the credential from the doc before this repository is pushed to a public remote or shared via CI artifacts.

Middleware bypass via cookie spoofing — mf_auth_present is never validated beyond presence; any browser client can set the cookie and reach the route shell of any protected page. Audit server-side data fetching in protected pages to confirm nothing sensitive renders without a successful API call.

initAuth does not validate token expiry before restoring the session — after a hard page refresh, initAuth re-sets mf_auth_present from localStorage without checking whether the access token is expired. The user passes middleware and sees the dashboard shell; API calls then trigger the refresh path. This is recoverable but causes a visible empty-state flash on expired sessions. Consider calling the token-refresh endpoint eagerly in initAuth, or clearing the session if the refresh token is also absent.
